en: The postcard features an ornate public square with a large, decorative fountain as the centerpiece. The fountain is surrounded by manicured lawns, trees, park benches, and elegant multi-story buildings showcasing 19th-century European architecture. There is prominent Scandinavian script on the card. The address side of the postcard includes a green Swedish stamp, postmarks, and handwriting in Swedish. The front of the card reads, 'Sundsvall,' referencing a northern Swedish city, along with handwritten greetings and a date from 1902.
